key.name: notch
key.description: Where the camera cutout sits at the top edge of the built-in display. The top bar moves its clock and icons out of the way. "auto" takes the cutout from the panel data of the device (/usr/share/plinius/display-panel.json, else gmobile).

key.name: notch-search
key.description: Whether a tap on the camera notch in the top bar opens a search for apps. A tap next to the search or on the notch again closes it.

key.name: app-grid-search
key.summary: Show the search in the app overview
key.description: Whether the app overview shows its search field. Without it, typing on a keyboard does not search either.

key.name: app-grid-app-names
key.summary: Show app names in the app overview
key.description: Whether the apps in the overview show their names under the icons. Folders and the apps inside a folder keep their names.

key.name: overview-running-apps
key.summary: Edge of the running apps in the overview
key.description: Whether the cards of the running apps stand above the app grid ("top", as in upstream Phosh) or below it ("bottom"). The overview follows at once.

key.name: app-grid-folder-dock
key.summary: Folders in a bar at the bottom of the app overview
key.description: Whether the folders of the app overview stand in a single row at the bottom edge that scrolls sideways, instead of between the apps.

key.name: always-on-display
key.description: Whether the screen shows the time, the date, the battery and the apps with notifications in the OLED's low-power mode instead of going off. Not during calls. Needs a panel with a low-power mode (phoc-plinius, MediaTek DOZE_ACTIVE); others go off as before.
